description_full: Booz Allen Hamilton Holding Corporation, a technology company, provides technology solutions using artificial intelligence, cyber, and other technologies for government's cabinet-level departments and commercial customers in the United States and internationally. The company offers artificial intelligence (AI) which creates purpose-built AI solutions that adapt commercial and technology to the needs of the federal government; cyber solutions; and legacy systems with cloud-enabled infrastructure, data platforms, and software applications.It also provides multi-modal data fusion coupled with cyber and AI for intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance, earth observation, and domain awareness and battle management; and quantum information sciences that provides quantum computing, quantum sensing, quantum communications, post-quantum compute readiness, and post-quantum cryptography. Booz Allen Hamilton Holding Corporation was founded in 1914 and is headquartered in McLean, Virginia.

financial_summary: Booz Allen Hamilton Holding Cor is a large-cap industrials business with a $10.2B market cap on $11.2B of annual revenue.
The top line has compounded at +7% over the past three years and +8% annually across the full decade, a respectable pace for a business of this size.
Returns on capital run at 20% against a 7% cost of capital — a 12-point spread that is the clearest signature of an economic moat.

The business throws off $951M in free cash flow — roughly 8 cents on every revenue dollar, which is the owner-earnings figure that actually belongs to shareholders, and cash conversion sits at 1.22× so those profits are backed by real cash.
On the balance sheet, debt is moderate at 2.7× net debt/EBITDA, serviceable in normal conditions but worth watching through a downturn, and interest coverage runs at 4.9×.

Management returns a meaningful 8.2% of market cap to owners through dividends and buybacks, a strong signal of disciplined capital allocation, and insider ownership is negligible, so management has little personal stake in the long-term outcome.
